question: How do I configure a custom base path for my generated SDK client?
ground_truth: To configure a custom base path for generated SDK clients, add the `x-fern-base-path` extension to the `info` section of your OpenRPC configuration file. For example, setting `x-fern-base-path: /api/v1/rpc` will configure the SDK to use `/api/v1/rpc` as the base path.
